scope: Nominal engineering screen only. These approximate graph readings are not manufacturer CSV data, guaranteed C(V) bounds, a measured waveform or USB compliance evidence.
observation: TDK public page, DC Bias Characteristic canvas, viewed 2026-09-20. Linear axes DC/V and Cap(Nom.)/F. Approximate samples read visually; allow about 1 uF reading uncertainty. TDK identifies graph data as reference-only and not guaranteed. Direct PDF/model downloads were rejected and browser CSV/model download attempts produced no retrievable artifact.
integrationAssumption: Treat the plotted incremental capacitance as dQ/dV on a single quasistatic charging branch and interpolate linearly. Frequency, hysteresis, aging, combined temperature/bias behavior and production spread are not qualified.
scaleMeaning: 1.20 times 1.15 illustrates nameplate capacitance tolerance and X5R temperature sensitivity; it is not a guaranteed joint nonlinear C(V,T) production envelope.

regulatorTiming.conditions: VIN=VOUT=3.6V, TA=25C unless otherwise specified; soft-start timing row has IOUT=0mA. This output timing does not control direct charging of C20.
